estimatedFinalCostHint: Forecast Final Cost = Actual + remaining commitments + expected remaining cost. Not a separate opaque engine.
estimatedProfitBasedOnEnteredData: Estimated profit based on entered data

kpis.currentContractHint: Original contract ± approved changes. Pending changes stay out.
kpis.pendingNotInContract: Not included in Current Contract until approved.
kpis.actualCostHint: Finalized direct cost, labor, vendors, shared, and allocated overhead on this project. Drafts excluded. VAT excluded.
kpis.allocatedOverheadHint: Share of business overhead allocated to this project. Unallocated overhead does not appear here.
kpis.allocatedOverheadSourceHint: From finalized allocation lines that target this project.
kpis.committedHint: Open purchase-order commitment — not Actual Cost. Stays separate until consumed.
kpis.forecastHint: Actual Cost + remaining commitments + expected remaining cost (ETC), without double-counting.
kpis.forecastEqualsActualHint: Forecast equals Actual Cost while there are no open commitments and no expected remaining cost.
kpis.expectedRemainingHint: Uncovenanted ETC entered on the project — not PO commitments.
kpis.committedInForecastHint: Open PO remaining commitment included once in Forecast Final Cost.
kpis.billedHint: Invoiced amount on this project — not the same as Paid or Current Contract.
kpis.paidHint: Cash collected against billing on this project.
kpis.outstandingHint: Billed minus Paid (net of credits). Forecast collection, not Paid.
kpis.actualMarginHint: Current Contract − Actual Cost (net). Not a cash figure.
kpis.forecastMarginEqualsActualHint: Same as Actual Margin while Forecast Cost equals Actual Cost.

drillLinks.viewFinalizedExpenses: View finalized expenses for this project
drillLinks.viewProjectExpenses: View all expenses for this project
drillLinks.viewOverheadOnProject: View overhead allocated to this project

committedVsActual: Committed stays separate from Actual — not an expense
unallocatedBusinessCostsHint: Costs awaiting allocation — counted in organization expense totals, not in project profit.
orgCostReconciliationHint: Project cost totals (expense layer) + unallocated organization costs = organization finalized expense total. Workforce labor is project-only and sits outside that expense equation.
openApPayableHint: Forecast outgoing obligation from open vendor bills — not Expense actual

coverage.title: What is included in this calculation
coverage.explanation: This figure uses only the data you have entered. Sources you have not configured are listed so the number is not read as a complete picture.
coverage.notConfiguredHint: Not configured — this is fine if your business does not track it.

partials.foreignCurrencyLabor: {count, plural, one {# time entry is costed in another currency — not included in this total} other {# time entries are costed in another currency — not included in this total}}
partials.foreignCurrencyBilling: {count, plural, one {# billing record is in another currency — not included in this total} other {# billing records are in another currency — not included in this total}}
partials.foreignCurrencyCommitted: {count, plural, one {# committed cost is in another currency — not included in this total} other {# committed costs are in another currency — not included in this total}}
partials.foreignCurrencyAp: {count, plural, one {# vendor bill is in another currency — not included in this total} other {# vendor bills are in another currency — not included in this total}}

cashFlow.title: Project cash — Actual vs Forecast
cashFlow.actualHint: Payments on this project’s billing with a payment date in this month-to-date range.
cashFlow.forecastHint: This project’s Outstanding billing by due date. Not Paid.
cashFlow.outgoingDisclosure: Outgoing cash is not forecast here: no open vendor bills with due dates are in scope. Expenses alone do not invent vendor invoices.
cashFlow.outgoingAvailableHint: Forecast from open vendor bills by due date — not Expense actual cost.
cashFlow.undatedNote: Outstanding without a due date stays under “No due date” and is not timed into a Forecast bucket.
cashFlow.paymentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No payments in range} =1 {# payment} other {# payments}}
